title: Weave Forcing: Compositional Memory Routing for Interactive Long Video Generation
title_zh: Weave Forcing：交互式长视频生成中的组合式记忆路由

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in autoregressive video generation have improved temporal consistency over extended durations, yet interactive storytelling requires more than continuous scene extension: a new shot may combine characters and backgrounds from different historical shots. Whole prompt retrieval can overlook the distinct reference needs of individual components, while directly combining all historical memories may introduce unrelated visual content. To address these problems, we present Weave Forcing , a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. First, we use an LLM for semantic slot routing to decompose user prompts into character and background descriptions and explicitly select suitable historical references for each component. To isolate the required content, masked memory weaving uses contrasting attention maps conditioned on semantic slots to construct refined semantic masks, selectively exposing relevant tokens from compressed historical KV memories to guide the generation of the current shot. We further introduce coverage adaptive RoPE to adjust temporal offsets and memory retention according to no, partial, or full reference coverage, addressing visual artifacts observed when incomplete historical references are positioned close to the current generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Weave Forcing improves cross-shot subject and background consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频生成领域的最新进展已提升了长时间段内的时间一致性，但交互式叙事需要的不仅仅是场景的连续延伸：一个新镜头可能结合来自不同历史镜头的角色和背景。 整体提示词检索可能会忽视单个组件独特的参考需求，而直接合并所有历史记忆则可能引入无关的视觉内容。 为解决这些问题，我们提出了 Weave Forcing——一种无需训练的框架，用于交互式长视频生成中的组合式记忆复用。 首先，我们使用一个大语言模型进行语义槽路由，将用户提示词分解为角色和背景描述，并明确为每个组件选择合适历史参考。 为隔离所需内容，掩码记忆编织利用基于语义槽的条件对比注意力图来构建精细的语义掩码，选择性暴露压缩后的历史 KV 记忆中相关的词元，以指导当前镜头的生成。 我们还引入了覆盖自适应 RoPE，根据参考内容的无覆盖、部分覆盖或完全覆盖情况调整时间偏移和记忆保留，从而解决不完整历史参考靠近当前生成内容时出现的视觉伪影问题。 大量实验表明，Weave Forcing 在保持具有竞争力的视觉质量和文本对齐的同时，提升了跨镜头的主体与背景一致性。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models have rapidly advanced visual realism, motion complexity, and text alignment ( Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . Autoregressive models further enable efficient, temporally consistent long video generation through sequential prediction, historical context reuse, and improved training and denoising ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . However, filmmaking and interactive storytelling require users to revise instructions, switch shots, and recall earlier characters or backgrounds. Interactive multi-shot generation must therefore respond to new instructions while preserving continuity with relevant historical content ( Lin et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型在视觉真实感、动作复杂度和文本对齐方面取得了快速进步（Kong 等，2024；Wan 等，2025）。 自回归模型通过序列预测、历史上下文复用以及改进的训练和去噪方法，进一步实现了高效且时间上连贯的长视频生成（Deng 等，2025；Huang 等，2026）。 然而，电影制作和互动式叙事要求用户能够修改指令、切换镜头，并回忆之前出现过的角色或背景。 因此，交互式多镜头生成必须在响应新指令的同时，保持与相关历史内容的一致性（Lin 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches can be distinguished by the temporal attention structure of their video generators. Methods built on bidirectional diffusion transformers (DiTs) produce high-quality clips and support composition across shots through joint generation or conditioning on historical frames. However, repeatedly denoising each target clip with bidirectional attention incurs substantial computational cost and high generation latency, limiting rapid user feedback ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026a ) . Causal autoregressive approaches instead generate sequentially and reuse historical KV states; combined with few-step sampling, they reduce latency while preserving long-range context and motion dynamics ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . Within this causal paradigm, global historical context and local within-shot context, together with shot-transition control, further support cross-shot consistency and interactive video generation ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026b ) . These advances improve interactive generation, but precise reuse of historical content for each new shot remains unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法可以通过其视频生成器的时间注意力结构加以区分。 基于双向扩散变换器（DiTs）的方法能够生成高质量的视频片段，并通过联合生成或以历史帧为条件的方式支持跨镜头的构图。 然而，使用双向注意力对每个目标片段进行重复的去噪会产生巨大的计算成本和高生成延迟，从而限制了用户的快速反馈（Guo et al., 2025; Luo et al., 2026a）。 相比之下，因果自回归方法以序列方式生成视频并复用历史 KV 状态；结合少步采样，这些方法在保持长程上下文和运动动态的同时降低了延迟（Yin et al., 2025; Meng et al., 2026）。 在这一因果范式下，全局历史上下文、局部镜头内上下文以及镜头转换控制进一步支持了跨镜头的一致性和交互式视频生成（Lu et al., 2026; Luo et al., 2026b）。 这些进展提升了交互式生成的能力，但如何为每个新镜头精确复用历史内容的问题仍未解决。

paragraphs.en: Two limitations arise when instructions combine content from different narrative moments, as shown in Figure 1 . First, historical references can provide too much unrelated information or too little relevant evidence. Reusing compressed or sampled representations of preceding frames preserves whole-scene content, including unrequested contents ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Conversely, selecting a single source by global prompt similarity, as in the optional automatic router of Echo Forcing, can miss required components across shots ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . For example, an instruction may bring a previously seen girl and boy into a library, with each character and the background originating from a different shot. Reusing all three source memories also imports unrelated content, whereas the most similar single shot may omit a required reference. Additional sources alone cannot resolve within-shot selection. Second, a uniform reference use policy struggles to reconcile two competing demands: preserving content supported by historical references and generating new content without such support. Strong historical conditioning can constrain unreferenced components, whereas indiscriminately weakening it can compromise the consistency of referenced characters and backgrounds. Infinity-RoPE demonstrates that manipulating temporal rotary position embedding (RoPE) coordinates can regulate temporal continuity and enable scene transitions ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ) . Inspired by this positional control, we adapt temporal RoPE settings to the availability of character and background references, balancing reference preservation with flexible generation of new content.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 1 所示，当指令结合来自不同叙事时刻的内容时，会出现两个局限性。 首先，历史参考可能提供过多无关信息，或过少的相关证据。 重复使用先前帧的压缩或采样表示可以保留整个场景的内容，包括未请求的内容（Zhang et al., 2025）。 相反，通过全局提示相似性选择单一来源（如 Echo Forcing 的可选自动路由器），可能会遗漏不同镜头间所需的部分（Wu et al., 2026a）。 例如，一条指令可能将之前出现过的一个女孩和一个男孩带入图书馆，而每个角色和背景都来自不同的镜头。 重复使用全部三个来源记忆也会引入无关内容，而最相似的单个镜头则可能遗漏必要的参考。 仅靠增加其他来源无法解决镜头内的选择问题。 其次，统一的参考使用策略难以协调两个相互冲突的需求：既保留历史参考所支持的内容，又生成没有此类支持的新内容。 过强的历史条件约束可能会限制未参考的部分，而随意削弱这种约束则可能破坏已参考角色和背景的一致性。 Infinity-RoPE 表明，通过调整时间旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）的坐标，可以调节时间连续性并实现场景转换（Yesiltepe et al., 2026）。 受这种位置控制的启发，我们根据角色和背景参考的可用性调整时间 RoPE 设置，在保留参考与灵活生成新内容之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose Weave Forcing , a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. Semantic slot routing uses a large language model (LLM) to first perform slot prompt splitting to identify the requested characters and background, and then apply cross-shot routing to associate each component with a historical source and its corresponding target slot prompt. Masked memory weaving uses contrastive slot attention (CSA) to distinguish target content from other content within the same historical memory, producing a semantic KV mask that selectively exposes relevant tokens. The references are combined in the cross-shot cache to guide the new shot. Coverage adaptive RoPE then adapts temporal positioning and reference retention to the available character and background support, while progressive memory decay smooths the transition toward the current shot’s own context. Together, these components enable selective recombination of historical content as user instructions evolve. Experiments on 100 six-shot prompts demonstrate the effectiveness of Weave Forcing, showing improved cross-shot subject and background consistency over the Self Forcing backbone while achieving competitive visual quality and text alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Weave Forcing——一种无需训练的框架，用于交互式长视频生成中的组合式记忆复用。 语义槽路由首先利用大语言模型（LLM）执行槽提示分割，以识别所需的人物和背景，然后应用跨镜头路由，将每个组件与历史来源及其对应的目标槽提示关联起来。 掩码记忆编织利用对比性槽注意力（CSA）区分同一历史记忆中目标内容与其他内容，生成一个语义 KV 掩码，选择性地暴露相关词元。 这些参考信息在跨镜头缓存中合并，以指导新镜头的生成。 覆盖自适应 RoPE 随后根据可用的人物和背景支持调整时间定位和参考保留，同时通过渐进式记忆衰减平滑过渡到当前镜头自身的上下文。 这些组件共同实现了随着用户指令变化而对历史内容进行选择性重组。 在 100 个六镜头提示上的实验证明了 Weave Forcing 的有效性：与 Self Forcing 基础模型相比，它在跨镜头的人物和背景一致性方面有所提升，同时实现了具有竞争力的视觉质量和文本对齐效果。

paragraphs.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Semantic Slot Routing , which decomposes each shot prompt into character and background slots and independently matches them to available historical source slots, enabling composition of references from different shots.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了语义槽路由方法，该方法将每个单样本提示分解为角色槽和背景槽，并分别将其与可用的历史源槽进行匹配，从而实现从不同样本中组合引用。

paragraphs.en: We propose Masked Memory Weaving , which constructs semantic KV masks through CSA, then combines the independently masked historical KV memories to retain requested content while suppressing unrelated characters and backgrounds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了“掩码记忆编织”方法，该方法通过 CSA 构建语义 KV 掩码，然后将独立掩码的历史 KV 记忆进行组合，在保留所需内容的同时抑制无关的角色和背景。

paragraphs.en: We develop Coverage Adaptive RoPE , which adapts temporal offsets and reference retention to no, partial, or full character and background reference coverage, balancing historical guidance with the generation of newly requested content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了覆盖自适应 RoPE（Coverage Adaptive RoPE），它会根据字符和背景参考的覆盖情况是“无”、“部分”还是“完全”，动态调整时间偏移量和参考保留策略，从而在历史引导与新生成内容之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Early work on autoregressive video generation connected causal sequence modeling with diffusion through independent per-token noise levels, enabling generation beyond the training horizon ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent approaches reduced sampling cost through distillation or adversarial post-training ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , while training on self-generated histories and rolling-window denoising helped reduce error accumulation ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Complementary system-level optimizations improve the efficiency of streaming deployment and long video training ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期关于自回归视频生成的研究将因果序列建模与扩散模型相结合，通过为每个词元引入独立的噪声水平，实现了超越训练数据时间范围的生成（Chen 等人，2024）。 后续方法通过蒸馏或对抗性后训练降低了采样成本（Yin 等人，2025；Lin 等人，2026），而基于自生成历史数据和滑动窗口去噪的训练则有助于减少误差累积（Huang 等人，2026；Liu 等人，2026）。 互补的系统级优化提升了流式部署和长视频训练的效率（Feng 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Interactive generation additionally requires responsiveness to changing instructions while maintaining temporal coherence. Chunk-wise prompting controls successive segments ( Teng et al., 2025 ) , while LongLive ( Yang et al., 2025 ) refreshes cached states under new prompts to improve transitions. Other work adapts positional encoding and cache management for extended rollouts and scene transitions ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ) , or constrains teacher supervision to balance responsiveness with stability ( Wu et al., 2026c ) . Extending interaction to multi-shot narratives further requires memory across shot boundaries: global and local contexts support streaming generation across shots ( Luo et al., 2026b ) , and Echo Forcing ( Wu et al., 2026a ) uses hierarchical memory for scene recall. In contrast, our work addresses compositional recall by routing character and background slots to historical sources, masking unrelated KV content, and adapting memory positioning.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式生成还需要在保持时间连贯性的同时，对不断变化的指令做出响应。 分块提示控制着连续片段（Teng 等，2025），而 LongLive（Yang 等，2025）则通过在新提示下刷新缓存状态来改善片段间的过渡。 其他研究针对更长的生成过程和场景转换，调整了位置编码和缓存管理（Yesiltepe 等，2026），或将教师监督加以限制，以在响应性与稳定性之间取得平衡（Wu 等，2026c）。 将交互扩展到多轮叙事，还需要在轮次边界间维持记忆：全局和局部上下文支持跨轮次的流式生成（Luo 等，2026b），而 Echo Forcing（Wu 等，2026a）则利用分层记忆实现场景回溯。 相比之下，我们的研究通过将角色和背景槽位路由至历史源、掩码无关的 KV 内容以及调整记忆位置，来解决组合式回溯问题。

paragraphs.en: Cross-shot reference reuse requires identifying the historical content needed by the current shot. Retrieval based on whole prompt similarity can miss characters and backgrounds originating from different shots. Selecting the top- k k shots alone does not resolve this issue, since global similarity neither assigns sources to individual components nor specifies which content to retain. We therefore use an LLM to establish these correspondences: slot prompt splitting extracts character and background descriptions, and cross-shot routing matches each component to a historical source and its target slot prompt as shown in Figure 2 (left). This assignment supports composition across shots and identifies the relevant content within each source.
paragraphs.zh: 跨镜头参考重用需要识别当前镜头所需的历史内容。 基于完整提示相似性的检索可能会遗漏来自不同镜头的角色和背景。 仅选择前 k 个镜头无法解决此问题，因为全局相似性既未将来源分配给各个组件，也未明确应保留哪些内容。 因此，我们使用 LLM 来建立这些对应关系：通过槽位提示拆分提取角色和背景描述，并通过跨镜头路由将每个组件匹配到历史来源及其目标槽位提示，如圖 2（左）所示。 这种分配支持跨镜头的合成，并能识别每个来源中的相关内容。

paragraphs.en: Historical shots selected by the router can contain relevant characters or backgrounds alongside unrelated content. Directly reusing their complete memories may therefore introduce visual information that conflicts with the current instruction. We address this interference through slot-specific semantic KV masks that isolate the requested content within each retrieved memory. paragraphs.en: As the current shot accumulates context, historical guidance must be regulated. paragraphs.en: We build Weave Forcing upon Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2026 ) with the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and use Gemini 2.5 Pro ( Google, 2025 ) for slot prompt decomposition and causal cross-shot reference routing. We generate videos at a resolution of 832 × 480 832\times 480 pixels with random seed 0 0 and configured denoising timesteps [ 1000,750,500,250 ] [1000,750,500,250] . The model generates three latent frames per autoregressive block, with a total KV cache capacity of 21 latent frames, allocated to the sink, compressed, recent, and current windows with capacities of 12, 3, 3, and 3 latent frames, respectively. All experiments are conducted on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU with 96 GB of memory.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate subject and background consistency at both intra-shot and inter-shot levels. We sample frames separately for intra-shot and inter-shot evaluation. We then use YOLO ( Redmon et al., 2016 ) for subject localization and SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) for segmentation, separating subject regions. DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) features are then extracted from the corresponding regions and compared using cosine similarity to measure visual consistency. We use VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) to assess aesthetic and imaging quality on each complete video. For text alignment, we apply the VBench ViCLIP metric ( Wang et al., 2024 ) to each shot and its corresponding short raw prompt (Appendix C ). These metrics jointly characterize visual quality, prompt alignment, and consistency across temporal scales.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单镜头和跨镜头两个层面上评估主体与背景的一致性。 我们对单镜头和跨镜头评估分别进行帧采样。 接着，我们使用 YOLO（Redmon 等人，2016）进行主体定位，并使用 SAM（Kirillov 等人，2023）进行分割，从而分离出主体区域。 随后，我们从对应区域中提取 DINOv2（Oquab 等人，2023）的特征，并通过余弦相似度进行比较，以衡量视觉一致性。 我们使用 VBench-Long（Huang 等人，2024；Huang 等人，2025）来评估每段完整视频的美学质量和成像质量。 在文本对齐方面，我们对每个镜头及其对应的简短原始提示（附录 C）应用 VBench ViCLIP 指标（Wang 等人，2024）。 这些指标共同描述了视觉质量、提示对齐以及跨时间尺度的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares Weave Forcing with representative bidirectional and autoregressive baselines. Bidirectional models exhibit stronger intra-shot consistency, likely benefiting from access to the full shot context when modeling dependencies among frames during generation. Although Weave Forcing does not lead in intra-shot consistency, it achieves the highest inter-shot subject and background consistency among the compared methods, demonstrating its strength in preserving both characters and backgrounds across shot boundaries. This supports the effectiveness of selectively reusing cache components relevant to the current instruction, rather than relying on a single historical source or uniformly sampled historical frames. Alongside these cross-shot consistency gains, it maintains competitive video quality, including imaging quality and text alignment. We attribute this in part to our coverage adaptive RoPE strategy, which adjusts the use and progressive decay of historical references according to the available character and background support, helping mitigate visual drift and unstable transitions. Overall, the quantitative results demonstrate the effectiveness of selective cross-shot memory reuse in preserving historical content while maintaining competitive visual quality and alignment with the current prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 将 Weave Forcing 与具有代表性的双向和自回归基线方法进行了比较。 双向模型展现出更强的单帧内一致性，这很可能得益于在生成过程中建模帧间依赖时能够访问完整的单帧上下文。 尽管 Weave Forcing 在单帧内一致性方面并非最佳，但在所比较的方法中，它在跨帧主体和背景一致性方面表现最优，证明了其在跨帧边界保留角色和背景方面的优势。 这支持了选择性复用与当前指令相关的缓存组件的有效性，而非依赖单一历史源或均匀采样的历史帧。 除了这些跨帧一致性的提升外，该方法还保持了具有竞争力的视频质量，包括图像质量和文本对齐。 我们认为这在一定程度上得益于我们采用的覆盖自适应 RoPE 策略，该策略根据可用的角色和背景支持信息调整历史参考的使用和渐进衰减，有助于减轻视觉漂移和不稳定的过渡。 总体而言，定量结果表明，选择性跨帧记忆复用方法在保留历史内容的同时，能够维持具有竞争力的视觉质量以及与当前提示的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows a representative interactive generation example. The first three shots establish individual characters, while later prompts require switching scenes and combining different characters. Self Forcing does not explicitly support free shot-level switching; in this example, its generated frames are dark, making their visual content difficult to discern. Methods such as LongLive can generate content that clearly deviates from the prompt, as marked by the red circles. We further observe that methods such as EchoShot and Rolling Forcing may match the requested scene but still alter referenced details such as clothing materials or trouser colors, as highlighted by the yellow boxes. This suggests that they may rely more on prompt-level matching than on faithful reuse of earlier visual content. In contrast, Weave Forcing better preserves these appearance details when composing characters drawn from different historical shots. This behavior is consistent with semantic slot routing and masked memory reuse, which provide relevant visual references while limiting interference from unrelated content. Additional qualitative results and analyses are provided in Appendix D and Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Table 3 ablates reference routing, semantic isolation, cross-shot guidance duration, and intra-shot history retention (implementation details in Appendix B ). Each component supports stable long-form generation. Without LLM-assisted routing, cross-shot preservation declines because global prompt similarity can miss required characters or backgrounds. Removing semantic masking reduces inter-shot consistency and text alignment, supporting separate isolation even for components from the same source frame. Without progressive decay, historical references persist excessively, hindering the transition to current-shot context. Removing intra-shot compression discards compact history, weakening both local consistency and cross-shot preservation. The full method achieves the best inter-shot consistency and text alignment, highlighting the need to jointly assess intra-shot and cross-shot criteria.

paragraphs.en: We presented Weave Forcing, a training-free framework for compositional memory reuse in interactive long video generation. Semantic slot routing uses an LLM to select historical sources for individual characters and backgrounds, while CSA constructs semantic KV masks to combine relevant memory content with reduced interference from unrelated components. Coverage adaptive RoPE adjusts temporal offsets and reference retention to the available support, balancing historical continuity with new content generation as memory decay shifts guidance toward the current shot’s own context. Experiments demonstrate improved inter-shot subject consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality and text alignment. These findings suggest that effective memory reuse for interactive video generation should prioritize the relevance of individual semantic components to the current instruction, rather than treating historical scenes as indivisible visual references.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Weave Forcing，一个无需训练的框架，用于在交互式长视频生成中实现组合式记忆复用。 语义槽路由使用 LLM 为单个角色和背景选择历史来源，而 CSA 则构建语义 KV 掩码，将相关记忆内容与无关组件的干扰降至最低地进行结合。 覆盖自适应 RoPE 会根据可用支持动态调整时间偏移和参考保留策略，在保持历史连贯性的同时平衡新内容的生成，随着记忆衰减，引导会转向当前镜头自身的上下文。 实验表明，该方法在提升镜头间主体一致性的同时，仍能保持具有竞争力的视觉质量和文本对齐效果。 这些发现表明，交互式视频生成中的有效记忆复用应优先关注单个语义成分与当前指令的相关性，而非将历史场景视为不可分割的视觉参考。

paragraphs.en: Summary. For every expanded scene independently, the semantic planner separates the description into a variable number of character slots and one background slot. Distinct visible subjects are represented by character1 , character2 , and so forth; a scene containing only one subject does not introduce an empty second-character field. This conservative decomposition retains static identity and appearance cues while excluding actions and poses. No cross-scene coreference resolution is performed during slot extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 对于每个独立展开的场景，语义规划器将其描述分解为数量不定的角色槽位和一个背景槽位。 不同的可见主体由 character1、character2 等表示；仅包含一个主体的场景不会引入第二个空的角色字段。 这种保守的分解方式保留了静态身份和外观线索，同时排除了动作和姿势。 在槽位提取过程中，不会执行跨场景的共指消解。

paragraphs.en: Each LLM request uses approximately 4,000 tokens in total, with an average reported throughput of about 130 tokens per second (TPS). Dividing this token budget by the throughput gives a coarse latency estimate of 4,000 / 130 ≈ 31 4{,}000/130\approx 31 seconds, or roughly 30 seconds per call. This estimate is indicative rather than a measured end-to-end latency: TPS characterizes token generation, whereas the total token budget also includes input tokens. Actual request latency therefore depends on the input–output token split and API serving overhead.

paragraphs.en: We use a common region-based procedure for subject and background consistency, both within shots and across the grouped cross-shot videos described above. For every sampled RGB frame, YOLO11n ( Jocher & Qiu, 2024 ) detects all COCO person instances at confidence threshold 0.25 0.25 . Each detection box is supplied to SAM-ViT-B ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) , which produces one highest-IoU binary mask per person. We encode each masked person crop and the complementary background image using the [ CLS ] [\mathrm{CLS}] ( Dosovitskiy, 2020 ) embedding of DINOv2 ViT-B/14 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) , followed by ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization. Person crops replace non-person pixels inside their bounding rectangles with a neutral value; for background features, the union of all person masks is filled by the median colour of the non-person pixels. paragraphs.en: The main paper presents a multi-person composition case, where later shots must jointly recover several identities. Figure 6 provides the complementary single-subject setting. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 6 , Weave Forcing achieves favorable qualitative results in this controlled setting. Compared with the displayed alternatives, the resulting sequence exhibits fewer conspicuous identity changes and maintains a more coherent correspondence to the previously established subject. This observation indicates that the proposed memory routing is also effective when consistency depends on a single recalled identity rather than a multi-subject composition.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 6 所示，在这种受控设置中，Weave Forcing 实现了理想的定性结果。 在连续拍摄中，它既保留了主体的核心外观特征，又适应了场景背景和事件发展方面的要求变化。 与展示的其他方案相比，生成的序列表现出更少的明显身份变化，并且与先前确立的主体保持了更连贯的一致性。 这一观察结果表明，当一致性依赖于单个回忆的身份而非多主体组合时，所提出的记忆路由机制同样有效。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 reports additional results for Weave Forcing without a baseline row, allowing the individual recall patterns to be inspected at a larger scale. The examples cover (i) scene recall, in which a previously established environment is requested again; (ii) subject recall, in which an earlier character must be preserved under a new context; and (iii) narrative development, in which the action or event changes while the relevant visual history remains available. Together, these cases show the range of reference-availability and story-progression conditions represented by the evaluation prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 报告了 Weave Forcing 在没有基线行的情况下的额外结果，从而可以更详细地审视各个召回模式。 这些示例涵盖了（i）场景召回，即再次请求一个先前已建立的环境；（ii）主体召回，即在新的语境下必须保留一个早期出现的角色；以及（iii）叙事发展，即相关视觉历史仍然可用时，动作或事件发生变化。 综合来看，这些案例展示了评估提示所涵盖的参考可用性和故事进展条件的范围。

paragraphs.en: The qualitative results show that Weave Forcing performs consistently across these heterogeneous scenarios. It can recover previously observed scene structure, retain subject-specific appearance after a contextual change, and support continued event development without simply reproducing an earlier shot. Although the visual requirements differ across the examples, the method generally preserves the requested historical content while allowing newly specified elements to evolve, suggesting that its routing mechanism is not restricted to a single type of cross-shot dependency.
paragraphs.zh: 定性结果表明，Weave Forcing 在这些异构场景中表现稳定。 它能够恢复先前观察到的场景结构，在上下文变化后保留主体特定的外观，并支持事件的持续发展，而不仅仅是重复之前的镜头。 尽管各示例的视觉要求不同，该方法通常能保留所请求的历史内容，同时允许新指定的元素演变，这表明其路由机制并不局限于单一类型的跨镜头依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: For visualization, we uniformly sample three frames from each shot and compare their subject appearance, local background, and spatial organization. The sampled frames show satisfactory intra-shot stability, with the principal visual attributes remaining coherent over the duration of the shot. We attribute this behavior to two complementary components: the compressed window retains informative latent K/V tokens from the recent generation history, while the Self Forcing backbone ( Huang et al., 2026 ) provides a comparatively stable basis for short-range autoregressive generation. Their combination helps limit local appearance drift even when routed cross-shot memory is simultaneously introduced.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进行可视化，我们从每个镜头中均匀采样三帧，并比较其主体外观、局部背景和空间组织。 采样后的帧展示了令人满意的镜头内稳定性，主要视觉属性在整个镜头持续时间内保持一致。 我们将这一行为归因于两个互补的组件：压缩窗口保留了近期生成历史中的信息丰富的潜在 K/V 令牌，而自我强制主干（Huang 等，2026）则为短距离自回归生成提供了一个相对稳定的基础。 它们的结合有助于限制局部外观漂移，即使同时引入了跨镜头路由的记忆也是如此。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 illustrates a failure mode in a crowded multi-subject shot. Although the generated scene retains both people, their appearance attributes are not cleanly separated: the lower part of the rear male subject is rendered with skirt-like clothing, while the female subject inherits the male subject’s hat. This is an attribute-entanglement ( Tang et al., 2023 ) error rather than a complete failure to render either subject.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 展示了一种拥挤的多主体拍摄场景中的失效模式。 尽管生成的场景保留了两个人物，但他们的外观特征并未被清晰区分：后方男性主体的下半身被渲染成了类似裙子的服装，而女性主体则继承了男性主体的帽子。 这是一种属性纠缠（Tang et al., 2023）错误，而非未能成功渲染任一主体。

paragraphs.en: The failure has two coupled causes. First, an imperfect semantic mask can retain spatial tokens from an adjacent subject, leaving insufficient separation between their respective historical appearances. Second, the new prompt asks the generator to attend to many entities and visual attributes simultaneously. The resulting competition for attention can weaken the slot-specific routing signal and cause the model to bind an attribute to the wrong person ( Chefer et al., 2023 ) . These examples suggest that more discriminative instance-level masks and explicit multi-subject binding are needed when several visually salient subjects must be recalled and modified in the same shot.
paragraphs.zh: 这一失败有两个相互关联的原因。 首先，不完善的语义掩码可能会保留相邻主体中的空间标记，导致它们各自的历史出现之间缺乏足够的区分。 其次，新的提示要求生成器同时关注多个实体和视觉属性。 由此产生的注意力竞争可能会削弱特定槽位的路由信号，并导致模型将某个属性错误地绑定到错误的人物上（Chefer 等，2023）。 这些例子表明，当需要在单次尝试中回忆并修改多个在视觉上突出的主体时，需要更具区分性的实例级掩码和明确的多主体绑定机制。
